name: Group Trip Cost Splitter
tagline: Split trip costs among friends easily.
description: Input your total trip expenses and number of travelers to see how much each person owes. Perfect for groups planning vacations together without the hassle of tracking individual expenses.
metaTitle: Group Trip Cost Splitter – Fair Trip Expense Sharing | Free Online Tool
metaDescription: Easily split your group trip costs for free, with no signup needed. Get fair expense sharing results instantly!

faqs.question: How do I use the cost splitter?
faqs.answer: Enter your total trip expenses and the number of travelers to calculate individual shares.

faqs.question: Can I add different types of expenses?
faqs.answer: Currently, the tool calculates a total split based on one input expense amount.

faqs.question: Is this tool free?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Group Trip Cost Splitter is completely free to use.
